clue.text: One being impudent without being able to stop the flow of current

definitions.text: able to stop the flow of current

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside: the impudent word goes round the one

parts.note: being impudent is insulting someone
one can be the article a

explanation.surface: A cheeky person is told they cannot stop the flow of a stream.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' here means outside, so INSULTING wraps round A.
explanation.definitionFit: Insulation materials block electrical current, so an insulating layer can stop it flowing.

clue.text: The middle of a day whichever way you regard it

indicators.note: whichever way you regard it says the word reads the same from either end

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A remark that midday looks the same from any angle.
explanation.definitionFit: Midday, twelve o'clock, sits at the centre of the daylight hours.

clue.text: Enquire after a Frenchman to discover his identity

indicators.note: after places the word for enquire behind the French pieces

parts.note: un is French for a
M is the abbreviation for Monsieur, a Frenchman
to enquire is to ask

explanation.surface: Questioning a Frenchman to find out who he really is.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a Frenchman' splits: UN is French for 'a', M is Monsieur.
explanation.definitionFit: To remove a disguise or mask is to reveal who someone truly is.

clue.text: One who can't remember confuses 99 names

indicators.note: confuses tells us to jumble the letters that follow

parts.note: IC is 99 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A forgetful person muddles up ninety-nine names.
explanation.definitionFit: Amnesia is memory loss, and a sufferer from it is called this.

clue.text: I study a religious picture

parts.note: to con is to study or pore over

explanation.surface: Someone says they examine a holy painting.
explanation.definitionFit: Eastern Orthodox churches venerate painted images of saints, called by this name.

clue.text: Sweet which might make ones mouth fall open

definitions.text: Sweet which might make ones mouth fall open

parts.words: Sweet which might make ones mouth fall open
parts.note: a sticky chewy sweet reads as gums dropping, the jaw sagging open

explanation.surface: A candy so astonishing it leaves you gaping.
explanation.definitionFit: A gelatin-based chewy confection, often sugar-coated, is named for its gummy texture.

clue.text: Can't be without diamonds-that's very evident!

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside: the inability words go round the gems

parts.note: can't be is split into not able
ice is slang for diamonds

explanation.surface: A boast that one simply must wear diamonds because that is obvious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is the old sense of outside, and 'ice' for diamonds is underworld slang.
explanation.definitionFit: Something easily spotted or obvious is one that can be observed readily.

clue.text: Plans to make nasty pics

parts.note: blue means smutty or indecent
prints are photographs or pictures

explanation.surface: Someone intends to produce dirty photos.
explanation.definitionFit: Architects' technical drawings were once copied as white lines on blue paper.

clue.text: Aim at the end

definitions.meaning: an aim is an objective or target
the end is the final purpose aimed for

explanation.definitionFit: Both an objective and a final destination or purpose go by this word.

clue.text: It doesn't seem to be a very select place for students to gather

definitions.text: It doesn't seem to be a very select place for students to gather

parts.words: It doesn't seem to be a very select place for students to gather
parts.note: a place that sounds vulgar and ordinary, yet is the shared lounge of a college

explanation.surface: Scorn for a student hangout that seems far from exclusive.
explanation.definitionFit: Colleges have a shared lounge used by students or staff, named for being open to all.

clue.text: Wish that superior fellow would jump in the river!

indicators.note: jump in puts the title into the waterway

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain
sir is a title for a superior man

explanation.surface: Wishing a pompous fellow would leap into a river.
explanation.walkthrough: The Dee is a river in Scotland and in Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: A wish or longing is a synonym, as noun or verb.

clue.text: Where the crew might sit to watch the fighting

definitions.meaning: the flight deck where a plane's crew sits
the arena where spectators watched cockfights

explanation.surface: A place where a crew sits to watch a fight.
explanation.definitionFit: The pilot's compartment of an aircraft and the old pit for gamecock fights share this name.

clue.text: He might ape the author in producing advertising material

definitions.text: He might ape the author in producing advertising material

parts.note: to ape is to copy or imitate
an author is a writer

explanation.surface: Someone imitating a famous author's style to write ads.
explanation.definitionFit: Ad agencies employ people who write the text, called copy, of advertisements.

clue.text: One who tries the one hundred on trial over a worker

indicators.note: in a down clue over places the test words above the insect

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
on trial means on test
a worker is an ant, the classic worker insect

explanation.surface: A hundred people on trial over a labourer.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, 'over' means above, so ON TEST comes before ANT.
explanation.definitionFit: A competitor makes an attempt, entering a competition to try to win.

clue.text: Ran it around the track perhaps

definitions.text: Ran it around the track perhaps

indicators.note: around tells us the letters are moved about

explanation.surface: Someone ran it round the athletics track.
explanation.walkthrough: A train runs round a railway track; 'track' wants to be athletics.
explanation.definitionFit: A railway locomotive with carriages runs along rails.

clue.text: An ancestor would be patient

definitions.meaning: an ancestor, a variant spelling of forebear
to hold back or refrain patiently

explanation.surface: An ancestor who would show patience.
explanation.definitionFit: Spelt as one word it means to refrain with restraint; it is also a variant for a forefather.

clue.text: Spread quickly round one point

indicators.note: round says the speedy word surrounds the compass point

parts.note: fast means quickly
E is the compass point east

explanation.surface: A rumour spread swiftly around one location.
explanation.definitionFit: A spread is a lavish meal laid out, a banquet.

clue.text: A large number look back-but edge forwards

parts.note: C, a hundred in Roman numerals, is a large number

indicators.note: back says the word for look is read in reverse

parts.note: to peer is to look

explanation.surface: A crowd glances behind while inching ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: To move slowly and stealthily, edging along, is a synonym.

clue.text: Floating pound in Dublin?

definitions.meaning: a flat boat floating on a river, propelled by a pole
the Irish pound, the old currency of Ireland

explanation.surface: Asking whether Ireland's currency floats.
explanation.definitionFit: Ireland's pound before the euro and a flat-bottomed river boat share this name.

clue.text: Black stuff made from crushed bone

indicators.note: crushed says the letters are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A dark substance produced by grinding bones.
explanation.definitionFit: A poetic word for ebony, the dark wood, and for blackness.

clue.text: Drunken hints to the first yuppy

parts.note: tips are hints

indicators.note: the first picks the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Drink-fuelled advice for the first young professional.
explanation.definitionFit: Slightly drunk, merry from alcohol, is the sense.

clue.text: upset over 1000 for a smallnail

clue.text: Three feet on one limb!-—useful for sailors

parts.note: a yard is three feet
an arm is a limb

explanation.surface: A three-foot limb that is handy on a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: On sailing ships, the ends of the spars from which sails hang were used by crews.

clue.text: In which to succeed around here

indicators.note: around says the success word encircles the place word

parts.note: to succeed is to win

explanation.surface: A place in which to triumph locally.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal relative adverb meaning in what place or thing.

clue.text: Those who try planting flower in a back street

indicators.note: planting puts the flower into the road abbreviation
back says the street abbreviation is reversed

parts.note: an aster is a daisy-like flower

explanation.surface: Gardeners attempt to plant flowers in a back alley.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns the street abbreviation round, and 'planting' sets the flower inside the result.
explanation.definitionFit: Samplers of food or wine try it, testing quality.

clue.text: What a bird, it goes back after the cat on a square

indicators.note: after puts the reversed pronoun behind the cat
in a down clue on places the reversed pronoun above the square

parts.note: a tom is a male cat

indicators.note: goes back says it is read in reverse

parts.note: a T-square, so T

explanation.surface: An exclamation about a bird retreating after a cat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'goes back' turns the pronoun round; in a down clue 'on' means above, so it sits over the square.
explanation.definitionFit: A small British songbird, a blue tit, goes by this name.

clue.text: Sound in perception

parts.note: tact is sensitivity or perception in dealing with others

explanation.surface: Being of sound mind in one's perception.
explanation.definitionFit: Sound here means undamaged or whole.

clue.text: Nice king trying to stem the tide without article

indicators.note: without says the article is removed

parts.words: king trying to stem the tide
parts.note: King Canute (Cnut) famously tried to hold back the tide
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A pleasant king struggles against the sea, minus an article.
explanation.walkthrough: The legend has King Canute ordering the tide to stop.
explanation.definitionFit: Cute means pretty or pleasing, as nice can.

clue.text: Plant a cooking pot on the cooker after this manner

indicators.note: on puts the pot after the cooker in an across clue

parts.note: an Aga is a British range cooker
a pan is a cooking pot
thus means in this way

explanation.surface: Instructions to place a cooking pot on the stove in this way.
explanation.walkthrough: AGA is a heavy British cast-iron range cooker.
explanation.definitionFit: The African lily is a flowering plant with blue blooms.

clue.text: Neat active volcano

indicators.note: active suggests the letters are lively and rearranged

explanation.surface: A tidy volcano still erupting.
explanation.definitionFit: Sicily's great volcano is the best-known example.

clue.text: Arranged mile trek so as to measure distance

indicators.note: arranged says these letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A mile-long hike planned in order to gauge distance.
explanation.definitionFit: Metric units of length, a thousand metres each, used to gauge distance.
